footnote: Source: Bilibili Q3 2025 earnings call, SteamDB snapshot August 2026, Dyson Sphere Program publisher's release. Photo AI-generated
notes: Below the ceiling, small teams have their own road. Escape from Duckov launched on October 16, 2025. On its Q3 2025 earnings call the publisher said it sold more than 3 million copies across platforms in under a month. That is the publisher's figure. Its Steam peak was about 300,000, per a SteamDB snapshot from August 2026. Dyson Sphere Program was made by a team of five and sold 200,000 copies in its first four days of early access, according to the publisher's January 2021 release. Neither is a triple-A game. Both have a clear core loop and a scope the team could hold. The photo is AI-generated.
